title: John 1:1–18 — Bespoke Saints English
priority: New Testament first, as requested by Vince in this task
source_scope: All 18 verses and 252 Greek tokens; no migration to UBS6/GNT6. Open SBLGNT is a licensed token/edition-comparison witness, not a silent change of base.

source_comparison.lexical_sequence: No lexical-sequence differences observed between displayed NA28 and the SBLGNT witness in John 1:1–18, ignoring case, elision glyphs and punctuation-conditioned accents.
punctuation_differences: NA28 adds a comma before sent in 1:6.
NA28 sets off the relative clause in 1:9 with commas; SBLGNT does not. This does not by itself settle the participle’s attachment.
SBLGNT encloses 1:15 in parentheses and ends 1:14 with a middle dot; NA28 presents 1:14 and 1:15 as separate sentences.
SBLGNT includes edition-apparatus markers at 1:15,16,18; these are not source tokens.
